title: Senescence-Associated Checkpoint Gene Dysregulation in Established Osteoarthritis: Integrated Transcriptomic Analysis and In Vitro Evaluation of CDK6 and WEE1.
authors: Liao, Chang-Sheng; Ju, Yu-Can; Wang, Min-Xiao; Long, Cheng; Lan, Feng-Jun
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦骨关节炎衰老相关基因表达与CDK6/WEE1的转录组分析及湿实验验证，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、TF-DNA结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Background/Objectives: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a whole-joint disease, and cellular senescence is one of several processes associated with cartilage degeneration. This study aimed to identify senescence-associated differentially expressed genes in established OA and to examine checkpoint-related candidates without assuming a causal checkpoint-imbalance mechanism. Methods: Five Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) datasets spanning articular-cartilage tissue and primary cartilage-derived chondrocytes (GSE57218, GSE117999, GSE114007, GSE246425, and GSE169077) were integrated as a training cohort; the meniscus dataset GSE98918 was reserved as an independent cross-tissue validation cohort. OA-associated differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were intersected with CELLAGE genes. Enrichment, protein-protein interaction, transcription-factor, competing endogenous RNA, drug-enrichment, and molecular-docking analyses were performed. CDK6 and WEE1 expression was evaluated in IL-1beta-treated human C28/I2 chondrocytes by RT-qPCR and representative Western blotting. Results: Forty-one senescence-associated DEGs were identified, and seven network-central genes (CDKN1A, CDK6, WEE1, NFKB2, ID1, RBL2, and IGFBP7) were prioritized. CDKN1A, CDK6, and WEE1 were reduced in OA-associated meniscal samples in GSE98918; within-dataset ROC analyses yielded AUCs of 0.931, 0.882, and 0.792, respectively. In IL-1beta-treated C28/I2 cells, WEE1 mRNA decreased whereas CDK6 mRNA increased; representative immunoblots showed concordant qualitative trends. Berberine- and folic acid-related docking findings were computational only. Conclusions: Checkpoint-related gene expression is associated with senescence-linked transcriptomic changes in established OA. The discordant CDK6 results between clinical tissue datasets and an acute inflammatory cell model do not establish stage-dependent regulation. The present data also do not demonstrate p53-mediated CDKN1A activation, checkpoint failure, cell-cycle arrest, or cellular senescence; these hypotheses require dedicated functional experiments.
abstract_zh: 背景/目的：骨关节炎（Osteoarthritis, OA）是一种全关节疾病，细胞衰老是与软骨退化相关的多种过程之一。本研究旨在识别已确立的OA中与衰老相关的差异表达基因，并在不假设检查点失衡机制的前提下，考察检查点相关候选基因。方法：整合五个基因表达综合数据库（Gene Expression Omnibus, GEO）数据集，涵盖关节软骨组织和原代软骨来源的软骨细胞（GSE57218、GSE117999、GSE114007、GSE246425和GSE169077），作为训练队列；半月板数据集GSE98918保留作为独立的跨组织验证队列。将OA相关差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs）与CELLAGE基因取交集。进行了富集分析、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用、转录因子、竞争性内源RNA、药物富集和分子对接分析。通过RT-qPCR和代表性Western blotting评估了IL-1β处理的人C28/I2软骨细胞中CDK6和WEE1的表达。结果：鉴定出41个衰老相关DEGs，并优先筛选出七个网络中心基因（CDKN1A、CDK6、WEE1、NFKB2、ID1、RBL2和IGFBP7）。在GSE98918中，OA相关半月板样本中CDKN1A、CDK6和WEE1表达降低；数据集内ROC分析得出AUC分别为0.931、0.882和0.792。在IL-1β处理的C28/I2细胞中，WEE1 mRNA降低而CDK6 mRNA升高；代表性免疫印迹显示一致的定性趋势。小檗碱和叶酸相关的对接结果仅为计算性发现。结论：检查点相关基因表达与已确立OA中衰老相关的转录组变化相关联。临床组织数据集与急性炎症细胞模型之间CDK6结果的不一致并未确立阶段依赖性调控。当前数据也未证明p53介导的CDKN1A激活、检查点失效、细胞周期阻滞或细胞衰老；这些假设需要专门的实验验证。
